subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Transcontinental Railroad
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Transcontinental Railroad usable.

hook.text: In 1869, two rail crews building from opposite coasts met in Utah. America was stitched together.

buildup.text: The Central Pacific built east from Sacramento. The Union Pacific built west from Omaha.

discovery.text: They raced each other for government land grants. More miles meant more money.

twist.text: A journey that once took six months by wagon now took six days by train.

climax.text: A golden spike was driven at Promontory Summit. Telegraph wires flashed 'Done!' across the land.

punchline.text: One spike turned two coasts into one country.

quiz.question: Where did the two crews meet to complete the Transcontinental Railroad?
